question: How do Purnia and Nalanda differ in training completion and six-month employment rates in 2023, in percentage points?

view.title: Purnia vs Nalanda: Training Completion and Employment (2023)
view.note: Each bar shows the percentage of enrolled women who completed training or were employed six months later in 2023. The insight above states the gap between Purnia and Nalanda in percentage points. Training completion rate = completed training ÷ women enrolled. Employment rate at 6 months = employed at 6 months ÷ women enrolled.

interpretation_guard.caveat: This data is a synthetic fixture and does not represent real programme outcomes. The gap between Purnia and Nalanda may reflect sample size or random variation rather than a meaningful programme difference.
